findings.title: Sidebar width mutated into persistent store on high-frequency drag events instead of pointer completion
findings.observed_behavior: Calling setSidebarWidth(next) on every pointermove event during sidebar resizing caused premature persistent store updates and full React re-renders of the sidebar hierarchy, breaking the contract tested in src/components/layout/sidebar.test.tsx:137-147.
findings.expected_behavior: Pointer drag updates only the inline --sidebar-width CSS variable on the DOM element for smooth 60fps rendering, deferring store persistence and clamping until pointerUp (finishResize).
findings.root_cause: An unintended setSidebarWidth(next) call was introduced in handleResizePointerMove during recent UI modernization, triggering store writes on every drag frame.
findings.impact: High-frequency React re-renders during mouse drags, state persistence before user completes drag gesture, test failure in sidebar.test.tsx.
findings.remediation: Removed setSidebarWidth(next) from handleResizePointerMove and ensured clamped width in finishResize: if (start) setSidebarWidth(clampSidebarWidth(start.width + event.clientX - start.x)).

findings.title: Release workflow blocks on strict i18n placeholders for newly added theme tokens and actions

evidence.snippet:
"verify:i18n:release": "node scripts/verify-i18n.cjs --strict --write-status && node scripts/i18n-locale-status.cjs --write && git diff -I '\"updatedAt\":' -I '\"lastUpdated\":' --exit-code docs/i18n/translation-status.json src/i18n/locale-completion-status.ts",
    "verify:contracts:release": "npm run verify:release-packaging-hardening",
    "verify:contracts": "npm run verify:contracts:static && npm run verify:contracts:features && npm run verify:contracts:release",
    "verify:release-readiness": "npm run verify:contracts && npm run verify:i18n:release",

findings.observed_behavior: npm run verify:release-readiness exits with code 1 due to 55 __MISSING__: sentinel strings in 11 non-English catalogs for new theme editor / palette keys.
findings.expected_behavior: All supported locales either provide translated strings or are reconciled prior to production release tag creation.
findings.root_cause: Recent theme editor expansion added 55 new token and action keys in en-US and filled other locales with __MISSING__: markers, which pass loose check verify:i18n but fail strict release check verify:i18n:release.
findings.impact: Release workflow .github/workflows/release.yml aborts during release preparation.
findings.remediation: Translate missing theme strings or run node scripts/translate-missing.cjs --write and synchronize docs/i18n/translation-status.json.
preconditions: Running npm run verify:release-readiness or tagging a release via .github/workflows/release.yml
findings.likelihood_justification: Executing npm run verify:release-readiness immediately exits with code 1 due to strict check

findings.title: Preload and test warnings regarding missing act(...) wrappers in asynchronous UI tests
findings.observed_behavior: React 19 testing library emits stderr warnings during OnboardingSplash.test.tsx and CommandPalette.test.tsx indicating state updates not wrapped in act(...).
findings.expected_behavior: UI component tests wrap asynchronous state transitions in act(...) or use waitFor to prevent console noise.
findings.root_cause: Unawaited promise resolutions or timers firing after test execution blocks.
findings.impact: Clutters test runner stderr; no functional production impact.
findings.remediation: Wrap state transitions in await act(async () => ...) or use waitFor.
